scores.notes: Both show a rough tufted lawn with hedgehogs enclosed by a red brick garden wall with trees and cypresses behind; the left's topiary arch and the right's foreground tree are compatible with a different viewpoint.

Left is an open lawn bounded by a red brick wall with fruit trees and giant card arches; right is bounded by a grey stone wall with tall clipped hedges and conical topiary and uses small wire hoops, so the enclosure conflicts.
Both show a wet sandy path between towering green wave walls under a dark storm sky leading back to red sandstone cliffs on the far shore.

Both show a patchy green lawn with hedgehogs and croquet hoops backed by a low pinkish brick wall and tall garden trees; the right's clipped hedge block and cypresses fit a different view of the same walled garden.

Both show a calm lake shore with a small fire, backed by terraced tan cliffs and a flat-roofed village with cypresses and palms on a point to the right; left is seen from the pebbly beach and right from the water.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same slim face and build, and a blue-grey cloak over a white tunic in both the boat scene and the fire scene.

Both show a table on grass under a large oak in front of a red-brick half-timbered house with a tiled roof; the table is bare wood on the left and white-clothed on the right and the porch differs, but the house, tree and garden agree.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a single mast, coiled ropes and a stern cushion on a dark sea under storm cloud; the right is a close view in the storm with no shore visible, which the left's distant hills do not contradict.

Both show a small open wooden boat with one mast on a grey-green lake under storm cloud with low tan hills and a small village on the shore; the sail is furled on the left and set on the right, a change that fits the two moments.
Peter (wading ashore on the left, leaping from the boat on the right) has the same curly grey-streaked dark hair, short grey beard, weathered middle-aged face and sturdy build in both.

Left shows a pale stone house courtyard opening onto green hills and a distant lake; right shows a stony hill road with olive trees, the same kind of flat-roofed stone houses and a distant lake between hills, which fits the same hillside.

Both show the same kind of open wooden boat with a single mast and rope-wrapped stern post on a dark heaving sea beneath storm cloud with dark headlands behind; the sail is furled left and flying right.

Both show a grey overcast lake with a small fire on a low stony shore and misty hills across the water; left looks at the shore from the boat and right looks out from the pebble beach toward a village point, which is compatible.

Both show a circular pit lined with large grey stone blocks holding lions on a sandy floor, with a stone parapet at the mouth; the left is seen from inside and looks more enclosed above, the right from outside in a sandy palace yard, which a change of viewpoint can cover.

Moses is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, carrying a tall crook-topped staff and wearing a brown cloak over a pale tunic in both; on the right he is seen partly from behind with wind-blown hair, but hair colour, beard and age agree.
Both show a ridged, furrowed lawn with hedgehogs enclosed by a long red brick wall with shrubs and tall trees behind it, with card soldiers bent as arches in the middle distance.

The tree, grass and white-clothed table agree, but the house conflicts: left is a low plain tan clapboard cottage with a simple lean-to porch, right is a tall pale grey-violet Victorian house with a steep central gable, arched upper window and ornate trim.

Left is enclosed by a grey stone wall with tall clipped hedges and conical topiary; right is an open lawn bounded by a red brick wall with a flower border and spreading trees, so the garden's enclosure conflicts.
The left shows only a rocky palm-lined shore at night with the sea still unparted, so the dry path itself is not there to compare with the right's sandy corridor between water walls and red cliffs.

Both show a long plank table on grass under a spreading oak with a pale clapboard house with a front porch close behind; the cloth covers the planks on the right and not on the left, but tree, house type and garden agree.
The lake and hills are compatible, but the boat conflicts: on the left it has a tall carved scroll-shaped sternpost rising above the men's heads, on the right both ends are short plain square posts.

Both show an open wooden plank boat with a rope-bound mast on a dark blue choppy lake with low green-grey hills under storm cloud; the left's curled sternpost is cropped out of the right's closer deck view, so nothing visible conflicts.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short dark beard, a slim face and a blue cloak over a white tunic in both the boat and the shore scene.

Both have a clothed table under a big tree, but the house conflicts: left is a cream stucco-and-stone cottage with dormers, a bay window and a small gabled porch, right is a weathered white clapboard house with shutters and a long columned veranda.

Peter (standing by the fire on the left, leaping from the boat on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned middle-aged face and stocky build, with a brown cloak in both.

Both show a deep circular pit of large grey stone blocks with a sandy rubble floor, open to daylight above, with a parapet at the rim where the king and guards look down; the winch on the left and wooden hatch on the right are compatible.

Both have a clothed table under an oak, but the house conflicts: left is a cream stucco cottage with a slate or shingle roof, dormers and a bay window, right is a thatched half-timbered cottage smothered in climbing roses.

Left shows a courtyard among pale flat-roofed stone houses on a terraced olive hillside; right shows a dirt road through the same kind of olive scrub leading to a pale flat-roofed stone farmstead with walled yards, which fits the same homestead seen from afar.
Both show the same kind of open wooden boat with a single mast, pale patched sail and square rope-bound end posts on a grey-green stormy lake with a low green-brown ridge on the far shore.

Moses is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard in a brown cloak over a pale tunic holding a tall staff in both; his hair is wilder in the wind on the left and he is seen in part-profile, but age, hair and beard colour agree.

Both show an open wooden boat with a single rope-bound mast and a tall rope-wrapped sternpost by the sleeper's cushion, in white-capped dark waves with a dark cliffed shore at right; the post ends in a curl on the right and is squared on the left, a small difference.

Left is a sunlit corridor under a clear blue sky running back to bare red mesas; right is the shore under a black storm sky with palms, sandy bluffs and a hilltop town, so both the weather and the shore the path starts from conflict.

Both show an open circular pit lined with pale weathered stone blocks, a sandy floor with lions, a parapet where the king leans and palms and dry ground above; the wooden doors at the rim on the left and barred gate on the right fit different sides of the pit.

Both show an open wooden boat with a single mast and plain square rope-bound end posts on a grey-green choppy lake with low green-tan hills on the far shore under storm cloud, clearing on the right as the text asks.
Daniel has the same close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard, brown skin and lean older face in both, with the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic and a small shoulder satchel.

Both show pale flat-roofed stone farm buildings among dry-stone walls, olive trees and terraced green-tan hills under a clear sky; the left sees the house from the road and the right from its paved yard, where arches come into view.

Both show the same dark open wooden boat with a single mast, tattered sail and square rope-bound sternpost by the sleeper's cushion, in black-green breaking waves under a rain-dark sky with dark cliffed shores.
Both show a calm pale-blue lake with a low pebbly sandy shore, a small fire near the waterline, olive trees and cypresses, small stone buildings and soft tan hills across the water in clear daylight.
Both show a wet sandy seabed strewn with rocks, shells and weed between towering teal wave walls under heavy storm cloud with a pale break in the sky at the far end of the corridor.

Both show a sandy path opening between green wave walls in grey daylight under a cloudy sky, starting from a sandy shore backed by red-tan sandstone cliffs; the right is the shore as the path forms and the left is inside the corridor looking back at those cliffs.
Jesus has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, long slim face and build, with a blue-grey cloak over a white tunic, in both the boat and the shore scene.

Both show the same dark open boat with a mast carrying a furled pale sail on its yard and a square rope-bound end post, in dark green breaking waves under storm cloud with dark cliffed headlands behind.

Both show a dark open wooden boat with a single rope-rigged mast and a stern cushion on a grey-green lake ringed by dark cliffed hills under heavy cloud; the storm on the left gives way to breaking light on the right as the text asks.

Moses is an elderly man with thinning white hair and a full white beard, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic with a crook-topped staff in both; on the left he is seen from behind in part-profile, but hair, beard and age agree.

Both show a sunken open-air pit lined with grey stone blocks holding lions, with palms and sandy ground at the rim where the king stands; the left looks wider and has a wooden door in the wall, the right is seen from above as a tighter ring, which viewpoint can cover.
Jesus has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard and slim face, with a dark blue cloak over a pale tunic, seated by the fire on the left and standing in the boat on the right.

Both show a shell-strewn sandy seabed between tall green wave walls in daylight, running back to the same flat-topped red sandstone mesas on a sandy far shore; the sky is a little cloudier on the left.

Both show a wet sandy rock-strewn path between rearing dark blue-green waves under a black storm sky, flanked by a tan sandy bluff on the left; the left is the shore as the sea opens and the right is further into the corridor.
Both show a clothed table on grass under a large oak in front of a pale two-storey clapboard house with shuttered windows, a panelled front door and a porch with slender turned posts and railings.

The oak and long table agree, but the house conflicts: left is a pale clapboard house with shutters and a railed veranda, right is a stone and half-timbered cottage with steep gables, leaded windows and tall chimneys.
Both show a calm blue lake shore in clear daylight with a small fire on a pebbly sandy beach, pale stone flat-roofed houses, olive trees and dark cypresses on a tan hillside behind.
